summary: The candidate fixes and expands a host-dependent backend-selection unit test, but it does not reproduce or exercise the original flashinfer_mxfp4 routed-expert loading failure. It changes no production/native code. Commit 60ff1e33 adds automatic backend selection; selection alone does not establish that the already-selected path can load the reported checkpoint without Hidden size mismatch.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced only the test fixture's leakage of the physical HIP platform into a mocked SM100 case; this is not the original Hidden size mismatch. Evidence: evidence/base-regression.txt
The host-independent routing test passed with SM90, SM100, and SM120 positive subtests. It did not load MXFP4 weights or invoke the reported failing path. Evidence: evidence/candidate-regression.txt
One module-level skip because the assigned GPU is AMD gfx950 rather than NVIDIA SM90. Evidence: evidence/sm90-test.txt

tests.command: prepared Python import-path and 8x8 GPU matmul check
tests.what_was_measured: Imported sglang from /job/repo/python/sglang and Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; an MI350X GPU matmul matched its CPU reference with max_abs_error 0.0. This establishes GPU availability only. Evidence: evidence/environment.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: A numerical check ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950. The issue-specific NVIDIA SM90 FlashInfer kernel did not run.
remaining_counterexamples: A detected MXFP4 DeepSeek-V4 checkpoint can select flashinfer_mxfp4 successfully yet still fail later while loading routed-expert tensors with Hidden size mismatch; the candidate never reaches that loader/runner contract.
The candidate supplies no failing-before/passing-after fixture with the reported packed weight shape [2048, 2048], scale shape [2048, 128], or TP=4 sharding.
No SM90 kernel execution demonstrates that loaded/permuted expert dimensions satisfy the FlashInfer Hopper contract.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights and four H800/SM90 GPUs were unavailable. Full model loading, TP=4, DSPARK, HTTP serving, semantic accuracy, and actual FlashInfer SM90 execution remain unverified. The available single GPU is AMD MI350X gfx950. No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changed only a Python test and report files.
